name: Agent Split
description: One shortcut to split the focused terminal to the right and start your coding agent (claude, codex, or any command) in the new pane. Two configurable slots, plus status bar buttons.

commands.title: Agent Split: open the first command in a right split

settings.title: First command
settings.description: Runs in the new pane for the first shortcut (bound to Show Checks).

settings.title: Second command
settings.description: Runs in the new pane for the second shortcut (bound to Show Ports).
